note: NEW monograph stubs. Regulatory and WADA values are seed hints (unknown until Hound Dog verifies). consumer_safe false. No dose fields.

entries.summary: Stabilised salt form of BPC-157 marketed for oral use. Stability claims are formulation claims, not efficacy claims.
entries.notes: Distinct from BPC-157 free base. Do not treat as interchangeable efficacy.

entries.summary: Full-length 43-aa parent molecule. G-actin sequestration, cell migration, angiogenesis, anti-fibrotic. This is what most TB4 literature studies.
entries.notes: TB-500 as sold is usually a fragment, not full TB4.

entries.summary: N-terminal tetrapeptide released from TB4 by prolyl oligopeptidase. Antifibrotic. Degraded by ACE.
entries.notes: ACE I/D genotype may be relevant to clearance.

entries.summary: Tripeptide without the copper complex. Different activity profile from GHK-Cu. Frequently sold as equivalent. It is not.
Thymulin requires zinc for activity. Studied topically for hair density. Very limited data.
CXXC5-Dishevelled interaction blocker in the Wnt pathway. Hair regeneration claims are preclinical only.
Mas receptor agonist on the counter-regulatory arm of the renin-angiotensin system. Anti-fibrotic and vascular research signals.
Immunomodulatory and mucosal peptide. Intranasal use in chronic inflammatory response communities has thin evidence.
Short peptide bioregulators from the St Petersburg Institute of Bioregulation and Gerontology. Family umbrella entry.
entries.notes: Evidence base is overwhelmingly single-institution Russian-language with limited independent replication. Required honesty field.

entries.summary: Recombinant human growth hormone. Reference standard for the GH axis class. Approved indications only in education framing.
entries.notes: US 21 USC 333(e) notice applies to non-approved distribution. Practitioner tier only.
entries.exclusion_reason: Prescription biologic. Practitioner educational framing only with 21 USC 333(e) notice.

entries.summary: Long-acting rhGH construct. Included for class completeness.
entries.exclusion_reason: Prescription long-acting rhGH. Practitioner educational framing only.

entries.summary: Long-acting rhGH construct. Included for class completeness.
entries.exclusion_reason: Prescription long-acting rhGH. Practitioner educational framing only.

entries.summary: GH receptor antagonist. Mechanistic mirror useful for explaining the axis.
Older GHSR agonist, largely superseded. Included for completeness.
Orally active non-peptide ghrelin receptor agonist. Sustained IGF-1 elevation with documented water retention, appetite increase, and insulin sensitivity reduction in trials.
entries.notes: Not a peptide. Commonly misgrouped with peptides. WADA S2.2 seed hint.

entries.summary: Ghrelin receptor agonist approved in Japan for cancer cachexia. Not FDA approved.
FDA approved (Macrilen) as an oral diagnostic for adult GH deficiency.
Discontinued GHSR agonist with hepatic signal. Cautionary class entry.
Truncated IGF-1 with very low IGFBP affinity, short acting, high local potency.
entries.exclusion_reason: Higher theoretical risk profile. Practitioner educational framing only.

entries.summary: Circulating follistatin isoform. FST-344 is the precursor that yields FST-315.
entries.exclusion_reason: Myostatin pathway modulator. Practitioner educational framing only.

entries.summary: Soluble ActRIIB decoy. Development discontinued for safety: epistaxis and telangiectasia from off-target ligand trapping.
entries.notes: Instructive safety story for the myostatin class.

entries.summary: Locally acting follistatin-based agent. Discontinued.
Anti-pro/latent myostatin antibody in SMA programmes. Shows the class pursued through a legitimate regulatory path.
Anti-ActRII antibody studied for lean-mass preservation during incretin-driven weight loss.
Closely homologous to myostatin. Famous for contradictory parabiosis rejuvenation findings that later failed replication.
entries.notes: Worked example of narrative outrunning evidence.

entries.summary: Triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon agonist in late-stage development. Among the largest weight reductions reported in the class to date.
entries.notes: Flagship-depth candidate. Investigational. Seed hint only.

entries.summary: Oral non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist. Structurally not a peptide.
Oral small-molecule GLP-1 RA. Programme status requires verification before consumer framing.
Approved GLP-1 RA (Victoza, Saxenda). Predecessor generation to semaglutide.
Approved GLP-1 RA (Trulicity).
Exendin-4 analog from Gila monster venom research. Approved (Byetta, Bydureon).
entries.notes: Rx. Origin story is genuine education.

entries.summary: Approved GLP-1 RA.
Approved then withdrawn commercially. Useful precedent entry.
Long-acting amylin analog in development.
GLP-1 and amylin co-agonist in a single molecule.
Approved amylin analog (Symlin). Important approved counterpart to unapproved amylin analogs.
entries.notes: Rx. Absence would make the database look promotional.

entries.summary: GLP-1/glucagon dual agonist with hepatic fat focus.
GLP-1 agonist and GIP receptor antagonist conjugate. Mechanistically the opposite GIP direction from tirzepatide.
entries.notes: Investigational. Teaching point on GIP directionality.

entries.summary: Long-acting GLP-1 RA in development.
FGF21 analog for metabolic and hepatic research.
FGF21 analog.
Native counter-regulatory hormone. Included so dual and triple agonist entries are comprehensible.
First-described mitochondrial-derived peptide. Cytoprotective and anti-apoptotic research signals.
Small humanin-like peptide. Emerging mitochondrial-derived peptide family.
Small humanin-like peptide. Emerging mitochondrial-derived peptide family.
NAD+ precursor. Not a peptide. US dietary supplement status has been contested.
entries.notes: Verify current regulatory position before consumer claims.

entries.summary: NAD+ precursor. Not a peptide.
Mitophagy inducer derived from ellagitannins via gut microbiota. Human muscle endurance trials exist.
Natural pineal peptide extract that preceded synthetic Epitalon. The field routinely conflates them.
Thymic peptide extract from the Khavinson programme. Immune and longevity claims with single-programme evidence caveats.
Longevity-associated protein and FGF23 co-receptor. Human KL-VS variant data links to Collection 11.
Genuine dipeptide. Carbonyl scavenging, pH buffering, anti-glycation.
entries.notes: Widely available and was missing while obscure research chemicals were present.

entries.summary: Methylated carnosine analog.
mTOR inhibitor and reference longevity intervention. Prescription immunosuppressant.
entries.exclusion_reason: Prescription immunosuppressant. Practitioner educational framing only.

entries.summary: Kinase inhibitor used in senolytic combination research with quercetin. Not a peptide.
Flavonoid used in senolytic combination research. Not a peptide.
Senolytic and autophagy research compound. Not a peptide.
Autophagy-related polyamine. Not a peptide.
Telomerase activator marketing claims. Include the marketing-versus-evidence gap.
Modified Semax marketed for intranasal use. Modification claims are pharmacokinetic, not efficacy.
Modified Selank. Modification claims are pharmacokinetic, not efficacy.
Polypeptide fraction from bovine or porcine cortex. Used clinically in Russia and CIS states.
ADNP-derived octapeptide. Failed a Phase 3 progressive supranuclear palsy trial.
entries.notes: Clean example of strong preclinical story failing in humans.

entries.summary: CNTF-derived peptidergic compound with preclinical neurogenesis claims.
NCAM-derived FGF receptor agonist peptide with preclinical memory effects.
Proline-containing dipeptide derivative frequently discussed alongside Semax and Selank.
entries.notes: Not a true peptide drug in the same class framing.

entries.summary: Approved vasopressin analog (DDAVP). Memory and social cognition literature exists.
entries.notes: WADA: prohibited as a masking agent (seed hint).

entries.summary: Thymopoietin 32-36 active fragment. Was marketed in some jurisdictions.
Zinc-dependent thymic nonapeptide.
Khavinson dipeptide immunomodulator.
Epithelial host-defence peptide.
Epithelial host-defence peptide.
Principal bee venom peptide. Cytolytic and pore-forming with real haemolysis and anaphylaxis risk.
entries.exclusion_reason: Haemolysis and anaphylaxis risk. Practitioner educational framing only.

entries.summary: Magainin analog. Failed to achieve FDA approval across two development cycles.
Indolicidin analog in topical antimicrobial and dermatologic development.
Zonulin antagonist studied for tight-junction regulation and celiac disease programmes.
entries.notes: Verify current trial outcome before consumer framing.

entries.summary: GLP-2 analog. FDA approved (Gattex) for short bowel syndrome.
entries.notes: The approved GI peptide the corpus was missing.

entries.summary: Guanylate cyclase-C agonist. FDA approved (Linzess). Oral peptide counterexample.
entries.notes: Useful counterexample to peptides cannot be oral.

entries.summary: GC-C agonist. FDA approved (Trulance).
Enterocyte fuel amino acid. Not a peptide. Often the compliant adjacency when users ask about gut peptides.
GnRH agonist. Continuous exposure causes downregulation and suppression, opposite of pulsatile GnRH.
entries.notes: Agonist versus pulsatile distinction is load-bearing education.

entries.summary: GnRH agonist with downregulation under continuous exposure.
GnRH agonist with downregulation under continuous exposure.
GnRH antagonist. Immediate suppression without flare.
GnRH antagonist. Immediate suppression without flare.
Modern recombinant alternative to HMG for fertility protocols.
SERM, trans-isomer of clomiphene. Commonly discussed alongside gonadotropins. Not FDA approved as a standalone product.
Vasoactive and antifibrotic. Failed acute heart failure trials despite promising Phase 2.
Anabolic-androgenic steroids and selective androgen receptor modulators are not peptides and are not covered by this database.
entries.notes: Boundary entry. Route hormone questions to Collection 13.
entries.exclusion_reason: Out of scope declaration. Not peptides. No monograph body.

entries.summary: Native melanocortin. Included so analogs and KPV relationship are comprehensible.
FDA approved (Scenesse) for erythropoietic protoporphyria as a controlled implant under specialist supervision.
entries.notes: Approved supervised counterpart to unregulated Melanotan II.

entries.summary: FDA approved (Imcivree) MC4R agonist for POMC, PCSK1 and LEPR deficiency obesity and Bardet-Biedl syndrome. Genotype-directed peptide therapy.
Most widely used cosmetic peptide. Parent of the Snap-8 concept. Topical.
Palmitoylated KTTKS collagen fragment. Among the better-evidenced cosmetic peptides.
Combination signal peptide system used in topical cosmetics.
Syn-Coll. TGF-beta pathway and collagen signalling in topical use.
Enkephalin analog topical, often paired with Argireline.
Waglerin-1 mimetic topical nicotinic acetylcholine receptor antagonism.
Topical MC1R agonist for pigmentation without systemic melanocortin exposure.
Topical cosmetic form of GHK-Cu. Regulatory posture differs from systemic GHK-Cu.
Heptapeptide mu-opioid agonist. Substantial abuse liability. No wellness application.
entries.exclusion_reason: Opioid agonist with abuse liability. Excluded adverse reference. No monograph body.

entries.summary: Present because insulin appears in performance stacking discussions. Non-clinical use is life-threatening.
entries.notes: Route to emergency and clinical care.
entries.exclusion_reason: Life-threatening non-clinical misuse context. Excluded adverse reference.

entries.summary: Erythropoiesis-stimulating agents. Contrast entry to ARA-290. Thrombotic risk.
entries.exclusion_reason: ESA thrombotic risk and doping context. Excluded adverse reference.

stacks.rationale: Localised repair plus systemic cell migration community pairing.
Adds matrix remodelling and dermatologic claims to repair pairing.
Adds anti-inflammatory KPV to GLOW-style pairing.
Canonical GH-axis pairing on two separate receptors. Mechanistic rationale exists; human combination data remain limited.
Older two-receptor GH-axis logic. GHRP-2 component may be added when monograph exists.
Cagrilintide plus semaglutide style combination. Genuine Phase 3 human combination data exists for the studied pair.
Lean-mass preservation during incretin weight loss. Pending fuller trial readouts.
Topical multi-peptide formulations with routine cosmetic testing.
